newsitem.title: POLAND: Nomura gives Mostostal-Z buy rate.
newsitem.headline: Nomura gives Mostostal-Z buy rate.

text.p: Nomura Equity Research rated the Polish construction company Mostostal Zabrze SA as buy, pointing out the firm's possible expansion on funds from new 2.6-million-share issue, Nomura said in its report.

It said in a report dated October 15 it saw no impact on the company's profits from a possible loss of a $10 million contract to build a broadcasting mast in Gabin, which was suspended by a court, as it would be granted penalty payments.
Nomura maintained its Mostostal Zabrze's pre-tax profit forecast of 18 million zlotys in 1996 and 1997 forecast of 27 million zlotys, up from 8.4 million zlotys last year.
Mostostal Zabrze closed on Friday at 11.1 zlotys.
